atoms.text: Kiran's birthday is on Sunday. I have to choose a birthday present. I have £20. He likes to play video games. There is a video game for £36. That is too expensive. And he likes to read books about horses. But there aren't any books about horses. He also likes to draw. There are pens for £15. That is cheap. I can give him these pens.
